messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — AcmeSub is moving their renewal to a different billing entity/subaccount and procurement is asking the invoice be issued to the new entity. They already signed the main agreement but procurement needs the vendor ID on the PO. Any blockers for the e-sign / invoice flow? :thinking:

Sam: Do we have the new vendor details? Last time entity changes hit VAT/EIN differences and finance flagged it.

Priya: Procurement attached a PO pdf that lists vendor: 'AcmeCorp Europe - SUBUNIT 42' and vendor code 54321. I tried to route DocuSign but it failed because our e-sign routing is tied to billing entity 'AcmeCorp Global'.

Leon (Legal): We can do a short amendment to the SOW to update the billing/invoice entity. Low legal risk, but it requires exec sign from the customer + our countersign. Timeline risk if procurement expects invoice before month-end.

Sam: If we go amendment route, can we keep the same pricing and term? CS needs to avoid any pricing churn.

Maya: Customer confirmed pricing/term remain identical — they just want invoices to show the new subentity. Would a billing metadata change (no contract amendment) be acceptable to finance?

BillingBot: note: automated invoice engine requires a legal billing entity on file before generating an invoice. Manual override is possible but requires Finance review + audit trail. Ticket: FIN-8421.

Leon (Legal): Manual override is fine short-term. I'll draft a minimal amendment clause: "Billing and invoicing entity updated to AcmeCorp Europe - Subunit 42 (vendor code 54321) for the renewal term starting [date]". I'll cc Finance for the override approval. @Sam can you confirm the exec sig contact?

Priya: On it — exec contact is julian@acme.eu. I'll request signature and attach the PO. They prefer DocuSign. Once Leon shares the amendment draft I'll add it to the envelope and ping procurement.

Maya: Great. Next steps: Leon drafts amendment, Priya requests exec sig and attaches PO, Sam coordinates the Finance manual override if needed. Target: invoice issued by EOM. :thumbsup:
